name: USD/JPY After BOJ Rate Decisions (VIX Overlay)
description: Analyzes USD/JPY forward return paths following BOJ rate decisions with VIX regime context. Shows: (1) fan chart with individual 20-day return paths for each hike event, (2) hold regime fan chart splitting holds by VIX > 20 (high-vol) vs VIX ≤ 20 (low-vol) average paths, (3) labeled scatter testing whether VIX level at hike predicts JPY reaction magnitude, (4) summary table with 3 rows (Hike / Hold High-VIX / Hold Low-VIX) showing N, median returns, and hit rates, and (5) event markers for each BOJ decision with VIX level and regime badge. VIX alignment uses prior-day VIX (lagged 1 bar) to reflect market conditions at decision time rather than FRED observation date.
source:
# USD/JPY After BOJ Rate Decisions (VIX Regime Overlay)
# Proxy: Japan call money/interbank rate (monthly FRED)
# Hike = rate increased MoM; Hold = unchanged or decreased
# VIX alignment: use prior-day VIX (>> 1) to reflect market conditions at decision time
# Hold events split by VIX regime: High-VIX (>20) vs Low-VIX (<=20)

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

# Japan call money rate (monthly, sparse on daily bars)
jp_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='IRSTCI01JPM156N')()
jp_rate_val = jp_rate_raw.result

# Detect new observations: raw value is valid only on observation dates
is_new_obs = is_valid(jp_rate_val)

# Current rate level (ffilled for comparison)
jp_rate = ffill(jp_rate_val)

# Previous rate: the rate at the prior observation
prev_rate = valuewhen(occurrence=1)(is_new_obs, jp_rate_val)

# Classify decision type on observation dates only
rate_change = jp_rate_val - prev_rate
is_hike = is_new_obs and is_valid(prev_rate) and rate_change > 0
is_hold = is_new_obs and is_valid(prev_rate) and rate_change <= 0

# --- VIX Data (FRED daily, lagged 1 bar for alignment) ---
# VIX on the FRED observation date may pre-date the actual BOJ meeting.
# Using prior-day VIX gives the market conditions at decision time.
vix_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='VIXCLS')()
vix_filled = ffill(vix_raw.result)
vix_val = vix_filled >> 1

# --- Hold VIX Regime Split ---
is_hold_high_vix = is_hold and is_valid(vix_val) and vix_val > 20
is_hold_low_vix = is_hold and is_valid(vix_val) and vix_val <= 20

# --- Forward Returns on USDJPY ---
fwd_5d = forward_returns(period=5)(close)
fwd_10d = forward_returns(period=10)(close)
fwd_15d = forward_returns(period=15)(close)
fwd_20d = forward_returns(period=20)(close)

# Filter by decision type
hike_fwd_5d = where(is_hike, fwd_5d)
hike_fwd_10d = where(is_hike, fwd_10d)
hike_fwd_20d = where(is_hike, fwd_20d)

hold_fwd_5d = where(is_hold, fwd_5d)
hold_fwd_10d = where(is_hold, fwd_10d)
hold_fwd_20d = where(is_hold, fwd_20d)

# Hold regime forward returns
hold_hv_fwd_5d = where(is_hold_high_vix, fwd_5d)
hold_hv_fwd_10d = where(is_hold_high_vix, fwd_10d)
hold_hv_fwd_20d = where(is_hold_high_vix, fwd_20d)

hold_lv_fwd_5d = where(is_hold_low_vix, fwd_5d)
hold_lv_fwd_10d = where(is_hold_low_vix, fwd_10d)
hold_lv_fwd_20d = where(is_hold_low_vix, fwd_20d)

# --- Decision type labels ---
any_decision = is_hike or is_hold
decision_fwd_5d = where(any_decision, fwd_5d)
decision_fwd_10d = where(any_decision, fwd_10d)
decision_fwd_20d = where(any_decision, fwd_20d)

# --- Fan Chart: Individual hike return paths (0d→20d) ---
# Capture forward returns at each horizon for the 4 most recent hike events
hike_e0_0d = 0.0
hike_e1_0d = 0.0
hike_e2_0d = 0.0
hike_e3_0d = 0.0

hike_e0_5d = valuewhen(occurrence=0)(is_hike, fwd_5d)
hike_e0_10d = valuewhen(occurrence=0)(is_hike, fwd_10d)
hike_e0_15d = valuewhen(occurrence=0)(is_hike, fwd_15d)
hike_e0_20d = valuewhen(occurrence=0)(is_hike, fwd_20d)

hike_e1_5d = valuewhen(occurrence=1)(is_hike, fwd_5d)
hike_e1_10d = valuewhen(occurrence=1)(is_hike, fwd_10d)
hike_e1_15d = valuewhen(occurrence=1)(is_hike, fwd_15d)
hike_e1_20d = valuewhen(occurrence=1)(is_hike, fwd_20d)

hike_e2_5d = valuewhen(occurrence=2)(is_hike, fwd_5d)
hike_e2_10d = valuewhen(occurrence=2)(is_hike, fwd_10d)
hike_e2_15d = valuewhen(occurrence=2)(is_hike, fwd_15d)
hike_e2_20d = valuewhen(occurrence=2)(is_hike, fwd_20d)

hike_e3_5d = valuewhen(occurrence=3)(is_hike, fwd_5d)
hike_e3_10d = valuewhen(occurrence=3)(is_hike, fwd_10d)
hike_e3_15d = valuewhen(occurrence=3)(is_hike, fwd_15d)
hike_e3_20d = valuewhen(occurrence=3)(is_hike, fwd_20d)

# Average path across all available hike events
n_valid_5d = (1.0 if is_valid(hike_e0_5d) else 0.0) + (1.0 if is_valid(hike_e1_5d) else 0.0) + (1.0 if is_valid(hike_e2_5d) else 0.0) + (1.0 if is_valid(hike_e3_5d) else 0.0)
n_valid_10d = (1.0 if is_valid(hike_e0_10d) else 0.0) + (1.0 if is_valid(hike_e1_10d) else 0.0) + (1.0 if is_valid(hike_e2_10d) else 0.0) + (1.0 if is_valid(hike_e3_10d) else 0.0)
n_valid_15d = (1.0 if is_valid(hike_e0_15d) else 0.0) + (1.0 if is_valid(hike_e1_15d) else 0.0) + (1.0 if is_valid(hike_e2_15d) else 0.0) + (1.0 if is_valid(hike_e3_15d) else 0.0)
n_valid_20d = (1.0 if is_valid(hike_e0_20d) else 0.0) + (1.0 if is_valid(hike_e1_20d) else 0.0) + (1.0 if is_valid(hike_e2_20d) else 0.0) + (1.0 if is_valid(hike_e3_20d) else 0.0)

sum_5d = coalesce(hike_e0_5d, 0.0) + coalesce(hike_e1_5d, 0.0) + coalesce(hike_e2_5d, 0.0) + coalesce(hike_e3_5d, 0.0)
sum_10d = coalesce(hike_e0_10d, 0.0) + coalesce(hike_e1_10d, 0.0) + coalesce(hike_e2_10d, 0.0) + coalesce(hike_e3_10d, 0.0)
sum_15d = coalesce(hike_e0_15d, 0.0) + coalesce(hike_e1_15d, 0.0) + coalesce(hike_e2_15d, 0.0) + coalesce(hike_e3_15d, 0.0)
sum_20d = coalesce(hike_e0_20d, 0.0) + coalesce(hike_e1_20d, 0.0) + coalesce(hike_e2_20d, 0.0) + coalesce(hike_e3_20d, 0.0)

avg_0d = 0.0
avg_5d = where(is_valid(n_valid_5d) and n_valid_5d > 0, sum_5d / n_valid_5d)
avg_10d = where(is_valid(n_valid_10d) and n_valid_10d > 0, sum_10d / n_valid_10d)
avg_15d = where(is_valid(n_valid_15d) and n_valid_15d > 0, sum_15d / n_valid_15d)
avg_20d = where(is_valid(n_valid_20d) and n_valid_20d > 0, sum_20d / n_valid_20d)

# --- Hold Regime Fan Chart: Average paths for High-VIX vs Low-VIX holds ---
# High-VIX hold average path (use cumulative median on sparse events)
hold_hv_fwd_15d = where(is_hold_high_vix, fwd_15d)
hold_lv_fwd_15d = where(is_hold_low_vix, fwd_15d)

# For hold regime averages, use cumulative mean on sparse filtered series
hold_hv_avg_0d = 0.0
hold_hv_avg_5d = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(hold_hv_fwd_5d)
hold_hv_avg_10d = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(hold_hv_fwd_10d)
hold_hv_avg_15d = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(hold_hv_fwd_15d)
hold_hv_avg_20d = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(hold_hv_fwd_20d)

hold_lv_avg_0d = 0.0
hold_lv_avg_5d = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(hold_lv_fwd_5d)
hold_lv_avg_10d = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(hold_lv_fwd_10d)
hold_lv_avg_15d = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(hold_lv_fwd_15d)
hold_lv_avg_20d = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(hold_lv_fwd_20d)

# --- Count events for summary ---
hike_count_flag = 1.0 if is_hike else 0.0
hold_hv_count_flag = 1.0 if is_hold_high_vix else 0.0
hold_lv_count_flag = 1.0 if is_hold_low_vix else 0.0
hike_n = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(hike_count_flag)
hold_hv_n = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(hold_hv_count_flag)
hold_lv_n = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(hold_lv_count_flag)

# Hit rates (positive forward return = USD/JPY rose = JPY weakened)
hike_hit_5d = 1.0 if (is_valid(hike_fwd_5d) and hike_fwd_5d > 0) else (0.0 if is_valid(hike_fwd_5d) else hike_fwd_5d)
hold_hv_hit_5d = 1.0 if (is_valid(hold_hv_fwd_5d) and hold_hv_fwd_5d > 0) else (0.0 if is_valid(hold_hv_fwd_5d) else hold_hv_fwd_5d)
hold_lv_hit_5d = 1.0 if (is_valid(hold_lv_fwd_5d) and hold_lv_fwd_5d > 0) else (0.0 if is_valid(hold_lv_fwd_5d) else hold_lv_fwd_5d)

# --- VIX at hike for scatter ---
vix_at_hike_e0 = valuewhen(occurrence=0)(is_hike, vix_val)
vix_at_hike_e1 = valuewhen(occurrence=1)(is_hike, vix_val)
vix_at_hike_e2 = valuewhen(occurrence=2)(is_hike, vix_val)
vix_at_hike_e3 = valuewhen(occurrence=3)(is_hike, vix_val)

# --- Event marker data ---
vix_at_decision = where(any_decision, vix_val)
rate_chg_bps = where(any_decision, rate_change * 100)
rate_level = where(any_decision, jp_rate_val)
decision_type_str = "Hike" if is_hike else ("Hold" if is_hold else "")
decision_str_filtered = where(any_decision, decision_type_str)

# VIX regime badge for event markers
vix_regime_str = conditional_select(
    is_hike, "Hike",
    is_hold_high_vix, "High VIX",
    is_hold_low_vix, "Low VIX",
    ""
)
vix_regime_filtered = where(any_decision, vix_regime_str)

# ============================================================
# OUTPUT 1: Fan Chart — Individual Hike Return Paths
# ============================================================
labeled_lines(
    title='How Did USD/JPY Move After Each BOJ Hike?',
    category='BOJ Rate Decisions',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    x_axis_label='Days After Decision',
    y_axis_label='Cumulative Return',
    data_labels=True,
    series=LabeledLineSeriesSchema(
        x_labels=['0d', '5d', '10d', '15d', '20d'],
        series=[
            LabeledLineSeriesSpec(name='Most Recent Hike', color=Color.Red, agg=AggregationType.Last, marker=MarkerSymbol.CircleMarker),
            LabeledLineSeriesSpec(name='Hike #2', color=Color.Sky, agg=AggregationType.Last, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
            LabeledLineSeriesSpec(name='Hike #3', color=Color.Slate, agg=AggregationType.Last, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
            LabeledLineSeriesSpec(name='Hike #4 (Oldest)', color=Color.Gray, agg=AggregationType.Last, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
            LabeledLineSeriesSpec(name='Average Path', color=Color.Blue, agg=AggregationType.Last, marker=MarkerSymbol.DiamondMarker)
        ]
    ),
    y_reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title='Flat')
    ]),
    order=1
)(hike_e0_0d, hike_e0_5d, hike_e0_10d, hike_e0_15d, hike_e0_20d, hike_e1_0d, hike_e1_5d, hike_e1_10d, hike_e1_15d, hike_e1_20d, hike_e2_0d, hike_e2_5d, hike_e2_10d, hike_e2_15d, hike_e2_20d, hike_e3_0d, hike_e3_5d, hike_e3_10d, hike_e3_15d, hike_e3_20d, avg_0d, avg_5d, avg_10d, avg_15d, avg_20d)

# ============================================================
# OUTPUT 2: Hold Regime Fan Chart — High-VIX vs Low-VIX Holds
# ============================================================
labeled_lines(
    title='Do High-VIX Holds Behave Differently?',
    category='BOJ Rate Decisions',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    x_axis_label='Days After Decision',
    y_axis_label='Avg Cumulative Return',
    data_labels=True,
    series=LabeledLineSeriesSchema(
        x_labels=['0d', '5d', '10d', '15d', '20d'],
        series=[
            LabeledLineSeriesSpec(name='Hold: VIX > 20', color=Color.Red, agg=AggregationType.Last, marker=MarkerSymbol.CircleMarker),
            LabeledLineSeriesSpec(name='Hold: VIX ≤ 20', color=Color.Blue, agg=AggregationType.Last, marker=MarkerSymbol.DiamondMarker)
        ]
    ),
    y_reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title='Flat')
    ]),
    order=2
)(hold_hv_avg_0d, hold_hv_avg_5d, hold_hv_avg_10d, hold_hv_avg_15d, hold_hv_avg_20d, hold_lv_avg_0d, hold_lv_avg_5d, hold_lv_avg_10d, hold_lv_avg_15d, hold_lv_avg_20d)

# ============================================================
# OUTPUT 3: Summary Table — Hike / Hold High-VIX / Hold Low-VIX
# ============================================================
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='BOJ Decision Stats by VIX Regime',
        row_size=3,
        col_size=5,
        row_headers=['Hike (All)', 'Hold: VIX > 20', 'Hold: VIX ≤ 20'],
        col_headers=['N', 'Median +5d', 'Median +10d', 'Median +20d', 'Hit Rate +5d'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    ),
    category='BOJ Rate Decisions',
    order=0
)(hike_n, hike_fwd_5d, hike_fwd_10d, hike_fwd_20d, hike_hit_5d, hold_hv_n, hold_hv_fwd_5d, hold_hv_fwd_10d, hold_hv_fwd_20d, hold_hv_hit_5d, hold_lv_n, hold_lv_fwd_5d, hold_lv_fwd_10d, hold_lv_fwd_20d, hold_lv_hit_5d)

# ============================================================
# OUTPUT 4: Scatter — Does VIX at Hike Predict the JPY Reaction?
# ============================================================
labeled_scatter(
    title='Does VIX at Hike Predict the JPY Reaction?',
    category='BOJ Rate Decisions',
    x_axis_label='VIX at Hike Date (Prior-Day)',
    y_axis_label='USD/JPY 20d Forward Return',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    x_axis_dp=1,
    points=LabeledPointSchema(points=[
        LabeledPointSpec(label='Most Recent Hike', color=Color.Red, marker=MarkerSymbol.CircleMarker, x_agg=AggregationType.Last, y_agg=AggregationType.Last),
        LabeledPointSpec(label='Hike #2', color=Color.Sky, marker=MarkerSymbol.SquareMarker, x_agg=AggregationType.Last, y_agg=AggregationType.Last),
        LabeledPointSpec(label='Hike #3', color=Color.Slate, marker=MarkerSymbol.DiamondMarker, x_agg=AggregationType.Last, y_agg=AggregationType.Last),
        LabeledPointSpec(label='Hike #4 (Oldest)', color=Color.Gray, marker=MarkerSymbol.TriangleMarker, x_agg=AggregationType.Last, y_agg=AggregationType.Last)
    ]),
    y_reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title='Flat')
    ]),
    show_trend_line=True,
    order=3
)(vix_at_hike_e0, hike_e0_20d, vix_at_hike_e1, hike_e1_20d, vix_at_hike_e2, hike_e2_20d, vix_at_hike_e3, hike_e3_20d)

# ============================================================
# OUTPUT 5: Event Markers — Each BOJ Decision (with VIX Regime)
# ============================================================
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='BOJ Rate Decision',
        icon=Icon.BanknoteIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Decision', type=CardRenderType.BadgeFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(title='VIX Regime', type=CardRenderType.BadgeFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.SecondaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(title='Rate Change (bps)', dp=1, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='Rate Level (%)', dp=3, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='VIX (Prior-Day)', dp=1, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(title='USDJPY +5d', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(title='USDJPY +20d', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Details),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(decision_str_filtered, vix_regime_filtered, rate_chg_bps, rate_level, vix_at_decision, decision_fwd_5d, decision_fwd_20d, any_decision)
